== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Known for his melee champions such as {{ci|Akali}}, {{ci|Sylas}}, and {{ci|Yone}}.
* Outstanding Rookie of the [[LPL 2021 Summer|LPL 2021 Summer Split]].
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on July 20, 2024.
** The 51st player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on July 31, 2025.
** The 30th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.

=== Individual Awards ===
* LPL Outstanding Rookie (Summer 2021)
* LPL 3rd All Pro Team x2 (Summer 2024, Split 3 2025)
